name: Mitsui Fudosan Accommodations Fund Inc.
summary: Mitsui Fudosan Accommodations Fund Inc. (MAF) is a J-REIT that invests in accommodation assets. Mitsui Fudosan Accommodations Fund Inc. defines real estate that is mainly used/maybe used for residence or hotels. Based on the Act on Investment Trusts and Investment Corporations (hereinafter Investment Trust Act), MAF was listed on the Real Estate Investment Trust Securities Market (J-REIT Market) of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on August 4, 2006.
